hooks.name: maverick-scope-guard
hooks.description: Blocks actions mav-scope-boundaries forbids. Generated by `maverick init --runtime kiro`; re-run it to update. Logic lives in the maverick CLI (maverick hook ... --runtime kiro).

action.command: maverick hook scope-guard --runtime kiro; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 42 ] && exit 2; exit 0

hooks.name: maverick-session-release
hooks.description: Releases this session's issue claims. Generated by `maverick init --runtime kiro`; re-run it to update. Logic lives in the maverick CLI (maverick hook ... --runtime kiro).

action.command: maverick hook session-release --runtime kiro; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 42 ] && exit 2; exit 0
